result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a duplicated restaurant card and a cut-off card at the bottom of the scroll view.

issues.description: The restaurant 'Green Bowl Poké' is duplicated side by side under 'Fastest near you' with identical details.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data fetching or recommendation logic to prevent duplicate listings.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is partially cut off by the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding to the scrollable container so the last item is fully visible above the bottom navigation.
